title: D2 encryption domains spec
description: Schema for contracts/encryption-domains/encryption-domains.spec.json — the source-of-truth catalog of encryption-domain identifiers. Each domain corresponds to an independently-rotated keyring registered via services.AddD2EncryptionFor(domain, factory). The 'plaintext' sentinel is included as a closed-catalog entry so spec validation on mq-messages.spec's 'encryption' field cleanly enumerates the only acceptable values. D2.Shared.EncryptionDomains.SourceGen reads it to emit EncryptionDomains into D2.Shared.Encryption; tools/ts-codegen/src/encryption-domains-emit.ts reads it to emit encryption-domains.g.ts into @d2/encryption-abstractions.

constName.description: Public C# / TS constant identifier — UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Must be unique across the spec.

value.description: Wire-format domain identifier value. Must be unique across the spec.

doc.description: XML <summary> / JSDoc text rendered on the emitted constant.
